verdict.rationale: Semgrep supports background automation via CI integration triggered on push/PR events, pre-commit hooks, and Managed Scans for bulk onboarding without CI changes, and the CLI is confirmed to run headlessly/offline without an account (probe-5, probe-7). However, this is traditional CI/CD-triggered automation rather than an AI-agent-orchestrated or scheduled autonomous workflow, and the documented MCP server (which would let an AI agent invoke it autonomously) failed to complete its handshake in a hands-on probe. Missing for 10: evidence of agent-driven/scheduled autonomous triggering beyond CI events, and a working MCP/agent integration for background invocation.
